title: Trade-offs in LLM synonym-substitution steganography: code, data and results
description: Code, saved SynSteg series and results for the article "Trade-Offs in LLM Synonym-Substitution Steganography: Steganalysis, Machine-Text Detectors, Adaptive Key Selection and Key Cost" (submitted to Computers, MDPI). Includes the decoding audit of 2175 saved stego texts, protocol A/B steganalysis results, the replacement-rate sweep, interpretable detectors, key-cost estimates, the corpus and scores of detectors of machine-generated text, the detector-guided key-selection study and the seed-key pilots. No API keys or keys of live channels are included.
